title: Release notes runway and cross-functional launch ops for API versioning change
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinated launch operations for the API versioning change that introduces v2 compatibility headers and soft-deprecation of legacy fields. Deliverables: release notes, migration guide, internal playbook for support/SEs, and a staged communications timetable. Ensure cross-team signoffs (Eng, Design, Docs, DevRel, Support, Legal) and produce a single source of truth for customer-facing messaging.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized release notes formatted for website and in-product changelog
Completed migration guide with code examples for Node/Python and SDK snippets
Support playbook published with triage steps and rollback messages
All cross-functional signoffs recorded in the signoff matrix
Release notes and migration materials scheduled for staged distribution per timeline
tasks: Draft canonical release notes (PM) - owner: Liam Chen
Technical migration guide with sample requests/responses (Eng) - owner: Priya Rao
Update SDK Quickstart snippets (Developer Experience) - owner: Mateo Alvarez
Design review for changelog microcopy and banners (Design) - owner: Hana Kim
Prepare Support runbook with common error scenarios and canned responses (Support) - owner: Claire O'Reilly
Create product in-app banner content and feature flag rollout plan (Product/Eng) - owner: Liam Chen
Legal review for commercial messaging and contract impacts (Legal) - owner: Sarah Gold
Coordinate blog + newsletter schedule with Marketing (Go-to-market) - owner: Devin Park
Publish release notes and migration guide pages to docs.redwood.ai (Docs) - owner: Priya Rao
Notify enterprise customers via account teams + create CTA for assisted migration (Customer Success) - owner: Noor Malik
communications_timeline: 2026-03-22: Publish embargoed release notes + migration guide to Partner Portal (sales/AE access)
2026-03-29: Soft launch to beta customers with feature flag enabled - collect telemetry
2026-04-05: General availability announcement (blog post + newsletter + docs site)
2026-04-12: In-product banner rollout to 50% of sessions
2026-04-15: Full banner rollout + deprecation notices in dashboard and quota emails
2026-05-15: Begin automated compatibility warnings to API callers still using legacy fields
signoff_matrix: Product: signoff on messaging and timeline - required
Engineering: signoff on backwards-compatibility tests and rollout gates - required
Design: signoff on in-product copy and banner visuals - required
Docs: signoff on publication and code sample accuracy - required
Support: runbook validated and SOC readiness - required
Legal: commercial language and SLA impacts - optional
Security: confirm no user-data exposure in examples - optional
release_notes_template:
Summary: What changed (one paragraph).
Why it matters: short benefits/impacts for integrators.
Compatibility notes: list of deprecated fields and recommended replacements.
Migration steps: minimal example + expanded SDK guide link.
Rollout timeline: dates for beta/GA and banner rollout.
Contact: support and account team links.

notes_on_risks: Risk: Unexpected customer regressions in edge tokenization cases. Mitigation: feature flag with quick rollback, targeted beta with telemetry alerts.
Risk: Confusion from simultaneous SDK updates across languages. Mitigation: coordinated SDK release notes and example parity checks.
Risk: Enterprise customers with contract terms impacted by API changes. Mitigation: CS to proactively notify top-50 accounts and offer assisted migration.
Risk: Incomplete support coverage during first week of GA. Mitigation: rotate additional engineers on on-call and prepare escalation matrix.
